How It Works

Four steps from discovery to creation.

FLYER turns passive listening into active participation. Every interaction feeds back into the wall — the more you use it, the more alive it gets.

01

Discover

Navigate city walls via the tube map. Each district has its own flyer cluster — Brick Lane sounds different from Shibuya. Swipe between sub-locations. Filter by type, mood, or trend.

02

Listen

Click any flyer to open it. Songs play via Spotify or BandLab embeds. Events show lineups and ticket links. Releases expand into full album players. Games launch inline.

03

Create

Post a flyer: pick your sound source (Spotify URL, BandLab track, or record a loop), design it (paper, font, shape), or just describe it and let AI build it for you.

04

Post

Your flyer appears on the wall — visible to everyone in that city. It collects plays, likes, and remixes. Other users can fork it or paste their own response next to it.

Discovery → Creation Primary loop

User discovers a track on the FLYER wall. Clicks "Open in BandLab Studio." Remixes it. Posts their version as a new flyer. The fork references the original — building a visible collaboration chain on the wall.

FLYER wall → click flyer → "Open in Studio" → remix → publish → new flyer on wall

Studio → Wall Publish flow

User finishes a track in BandLab Studio. Publish screen offers "Post to FLYER" as a distribution option alongside Spotify, Apple Music, etc. The flyer is auto-generated from track metadata + AI, or the user designs it manually.

Studio → publish → "Post to FLYER" → auto-generate flyer → live on wall

Live Events Real-time

BandLab Live sessions appear as pulsing LIVE event flyers on the wall. Clicking opens the livestream. After the event, the flyer persists as a recording — permanent artifact of a moment.

BandLab Live → auto-create LIVE flyer → pulsing on wall → recording after event ends

Retention Metrics Measurable

Every "Open in Studio" click, every remix, every publish-to-FLYER is a trackable retention event. FLYER becomes a measurable driver of Studio DAU and session length.

flyer views → studio opens → remix starts → publish events → re-engagement on wall
Caldecott Music Group Synergies

One wall. The whole group.

FLYER is a shared surface. Every Caldecott property gets a native presence — editorial, retail, events, and labels all post to the same wall users are already on.

NME
Editorial · Reviews · Features

Editorial flyers

NME reviews, features, and news articles posted as flyers in relevant city districts. "NME Pick" badge on featured artist flyers. Drives traffic from FLYER to NME and vice versa. Album review flyers auto-generated from NME content API.

Swee Lee
Retail · Instruments · Gear

Merch + gear flyers

T-shirt-shaped merch flyers and gear promo flyers linking to Swee Lee's storefront. "Shop the sound" — hear a track, buy the guitar that made it. Cross-sell from music discovery to instrument retail.

BandLab Live
Events · Venues · Streaming

Live event flyers

Caldecott venue events auto-posted as live event flyers with ticket purchase integration. Post-event recording flyers persist as archive. Venue-branded walls in partner cities become permanent FLYER installations.

Label Partners
Releases · A&R · Catalogue

Label release flyers

Labels under the Caldecott umbrella auto-post new releases as flyers in relevant cities. A&R teams use FLYER engagement data (plays, remixes, forks) as discovery signals for signing decisions.

BandLab for Education
Schools · Workshops · Programmes

Classroom walls

Private FLYER walls for classrooms — students post collaborative music projects as flyers visible to their cohort. Teachers curate and feature. Feeds into the public wall when students graduate their work.

Brand Partners
Advertising · Sponsorship · Co-brand

Promo flyer slots

Brands post visually distinct promo flyers (reserved shapes, red PROMO frame). Sold as placements per city per time period. Non-intrusive — they're ON the wall, not interrupting it. Scalable revenue stream.

Partner Integrations

Open platform. Embedded everywhere.

FLYER embeds the music services users already pay for. No walled garden — any audio source, any ticketing platform, any merch provider.

Spotify + Apple Music

Official oEmbed players inline on song and release flyers. 30s preview for free users, full playback for Premium. Chart data seeds the wall's baseline content per city.

Ticketmaster / Eventbrite

Event flyers deep-link to ticket purchase. Ticket CTA on the expand page. Post-purchase: "I'm going" badge appears on user's flyer profile.

Shopify / Printful

Merch t-shirt flyers link to Shopify storefronts. Print-on-demand via Printful for artist-designed merch. Commission per sale flows back to FLYER.

Google Maps / Cultural APIs

City backgrounds, street signs, and atmospheric palettes driven by Google Maps data + cultural datasets. Each city launch partners with local tourism boards for authenticity.

AI Generation

Users describe their flyer in natural language → AI generates the design (paper, font, layout, copy). Future: full generative flyer art from audio analysis. Powered by BandLab's AI infrastructure.

HTML5 Games

Arcade-machine flyers open playable HTML5 games inline. Music-themed games (Beat Invaders, Drop Cast) drive engagement and retention. SDK for third-party game developers.

Revenue Model

Four revenue streams. Day one.

01

Promo Slots

Brands buy promo flyer placement per city per time period. Visually distinct, non-intrusive. Scalable CPM model. Premium positions (top of wall, first on swipe) at higher rates.

02

Premium Features

Custom flyer shapes, analytics dashboard, priority wall placement, AI-generated designs, verified badges. Upsell to BandLab Membership tier.

03

Merch Commission

Percentage on every merch sale through t-shirt flyers. Powered by Shopify/Printful integration. Artist sets price, FLYER takes platform fee.

04

Ticket Commission

Referral fee on event ticket sales originating from FLYER event flyers. Trackable via UTM + deep links to Ticketmaster/Eventbrite.
